body:
Ma et al. (2024), DOI 10.12034/j.issn.1009-606X.223330, assign anorthite in Figures 1/11 but Table 1 reports 19.17 wt% MgO, 16.50 wt% Fe2O3 and only 4.06 wt% Al2O3. This is incompatible with pure CaAl2Si2O8. The curated record therefore accepts whole-feed fungal leaching and explicitly withholds phase-specific magnesium release and pure-endmember yields.

Resolve with a publisher correction, original compositional/phase data, or an author-supported explanation of the specimen and XRF table. Check the final leach-medium formulation as a separate reproducibility detail: Methods call it Czapek while Results say Mg/Fe were removed relative to growth medium.

Acceptance: document the supported phase assemblage or corrected composition, distinguish XRF bulk values from local EDS, identify the actual Mg-bearing phase only if directly supported, and independently review any record revision. Do not replace uncertainty with a guessed mineral. Source dossier: research/sources/round70-silicates/20261014T113302Z-source-investigation.md. Keep this source clarification open until evidence resolves it; the scoped current record can be published.
title: Clarify Ma2024 anorthite feed composition before phase-specific leaching claims
dedup_scope: All137 prior open/closed issues inspected for DOI; #219 is separately known gibbsite source gap. No matching source issue.
